description: TOP-UP ROW. Mapped as an OSM WAY (a drawn outline; not a point) named "A4 Skyhawk" with model:wikidata=Q334759; sits inside Taman Rekreasi Kuala Kangsar beside the Perak river esplanade. Almost certainly an ex-RMAF A-4PTM since that was the only Skyhawk variant Malaysia flew; the variant field is left blank because no source states it and the serial is unknown
